page.layout: One printed page: a title page. A central title block in a rectangular frame, surrounded by a decorative woodcut border. No running head, page number or other text outside the frame.
page.notes: Woodcut ornamental border around the title block, with a small ornamental device (fleuron) between the title and the printer's line. A handwritten "2" in ink at the top right corner, outside the border, is not printed and is left out. A faint brown ink stain sits over the centre of the title block, left of "Dialectica" and above "Ex officina"; it does not hide any letters. The date line is printed with wide spacing between the digits.
